content.short: STASIS combines the vast potential of the cryptocurrency market with the stability and reliability of traditional.
content.description: STASIS provides a full-service tokenization platform, including smart contract creation, third-party audits, custodial services, and deep expertise in current regulatory environment. Our tokenized assets are always backed 1:1 by collateral held in reserve accounts. We provide various reserve verification streams, including audits by a Top 5 global accounting firm, so investors are always confident that their tokens are fully backed. Tokenization is the process of representing real-world assets on the blockchain.
